theme.title: Fear the deer
theme.subtitle: Milwaukee Bucks, 2020–21
theme.recap: With Giannis at the center, Holiday in the backcourt and a deep cast, Milwaukee survived Brooklyn and brought a championship home.

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did the 2020–21 champion Bucks win?
questions.note: 46 wins, enough for the East's third seed.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Bucks finished the season with a 46–26 record

funFacts.text: Milwaukee swept Miami to open the playoffs after losing to the Heat the previous postseason.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Bucks began their playoff run by sweeping the sixth-seeded Miami Heat

funFacts.text: Jrue Holiday arrived from New Orleans in a complicated offseason trade.
Milwaukee claimed its Central Division title after beating Chicago in late April.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Bucks clinched the Central Division for a record 10th time with a win over the Chicago Bulls

questions.prompt: What was Giannis Antetokounmpo's points average in the 2021 playoffs?
questions.context: Milwaukee · entire postseason, not only the Finals
questions.note: 30.2 points per game over the Bucks' championship run.

funFacts.text: He also averaged 12.8 rebounds a game during that postseason.
Giannis started every playoff game he appeared in.
He was named Finals Most Valuable Player after Milwaukee defeated Phoenix.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Giannis Antetokounmpo was named NBA Finals Most Valuable Player

questions.prompt: How many assists per game did Jrue Holiday average in the 2021 playoffs?
questions.note: 8.7 assists a game from Milwaukee's two-way guard.

funFacts.text: Holiday started all 23 of Milwaukee's playoff games.
His late steal against Devin Booker set up an alley-oop that swung Finals Game 5.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jrue Holiday stole the ball from Devin Booker and passed it to Giannis Antetokounmpo for an alley-oop

funFacts.text: Holiday had been acquired from New Orleans in Milwaukee's offseason reshuffle.

questions.prompt: How many points did the Bucks score in their crucial Game 3 win over Brooklyn?
questions.note: 86 points were just enough to stay alive in the series.

funFacts.text: Khris Middleton scored 35 to lead Milwaukee in that defensive battle.
Brooklyn managed just 83 points, despite winning both previous games.
The Bucks later won the series in an overtime Game 7 on the road.

questions.prompt: What percentage of threes did Bryn Forbes make for the champion Bucks?
questions.note: 45.2%, a key source of floor spacing for Milwaukee.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.derivation: Source records .452 three-point accuracy; multiply by 100 for 45.2 percent.

funFacts.text: Forbes played 70 regular-season games but started only ten.
Milwaukee signed Forbes from the San Antonio Spurs in free agency.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Bryn Forbes | November 26 | San Antonio Spurs

funFacts.text: His three-point accuracy dropped during the title-winning playoffs.
